title: 制御工学Ⅱ
subtitle: Control Engineering II
teachers:
SUZUKI Ryoichi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
(1)	Learn the stability and control performance of dynamic systems and learn proportional integral derivative (PID) control.
(2)	Learn the state space representation, state transition matrix, and behavior of dynamic systems.
(3)	Acquire basic knowledge for state feedback control.
(4)	Acquire basic knowledge and skills for control system design and analysis.
advice:
This is another basic course in control engineering that follows completion of Control Engineering I.

Students are expected to actively participate in class reviews of basic mathematics (e.g., differential equations and linear algebra).

Students are expected to complete exercises independently and to identify their own abilities.

Students will acquire basic knowledge and skills to control robotic and mechatronic systems.
requiredKnowledge:
Completion of Mathematics for Robotics I and Control Engineering I.
Sufficient mathematical skill (differentials, integrals, differential equations, and linear algebra).

activityGoals.body: Apply knowledge of differential equations and linear algebra to the design and analysis of dynamic systems.
Calculate gain and phase margins, and determine the stability of systems.
Understand PID control and apply this control method to systems.
Understand state space representation and obtain a mathematical model using this representation.
Understand the behavior of dynamic systems and perform design and analysis to control objects.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is another basic course in control engineering that follows completion of Control Engineering I.

Students are expected to actively participate in class reviews of basic mathematics (e.g., differential equations and linear algebra).

Students are expected to complete exercises independently and to identify their own abilities.

Students will acquire basic knowledge and skills to control robotic and mechatronic systems.
